searchText: Sorry I should specify that x and y are multiprecision numbers, x>y. Hmm also not quite sure how shift would be applied here because the divisor isn't a power of 2. Oh I was assuming you were doing scalar operations up to your register size, so the SHL is just to compute x which is a power of two. Yeah if your x and y do not fit in a single scalar register then perhaps there are smarter ways than performing the full division. I don't have a clue, will think if no one comes here with a reasonable answer, my first intuition would be perhaps computing p=\phi(y) and replacing x=2^k by dividing k=p q + r and now your problem is computing 2^r % y which is surely scalar.
